newsitem.title: CHINA: Yanjing Brewery to list 72 mln A shares in Shenzhen.
newsitem.headline: Yanjing Brewery to list 72 mln A shares in Shenzhen.

text.p: Beijing Yanjing Brewery Co Ltd 0729.SZ said on Monday it would list 72 million domestic-currency A shares on the Shenzhen stock exchange on Wednesday.

The shares, offered at 7.34 yuan, carry a price-to-earnings ratio of 14 times on a fully diluted basis, calculated under average net profits over the previous three years, Yanjing said in a statement in the Shenzhen-based Securities Times.
The company would use the proceeds to upgrade technology and boost its beer production, which is among the largest in China, it said earlier in an offer prospectus.
Yanjing has appointed Beijing Securities Co Ltd and China Southern Securities Co Ltd as its listing sponsors.
After the offer, the company will have 310 million shares made up of 230 million state and institutional shares, 72 million A shares and 8 million staff shares, it said.
The company chalked up net profits of 143.5 million yuan in 1996, against 119.3 million in 1995, the statement said.
